body:
Camp minions now chase a target out to real attack range and give up beyond a leash distance measured from home, resetting HP on return -- real LoL-style behavior replacing pure passive proximity-attack. New Pyromancer archetype attacks from range like Gary. 3 new tests, 1208 PASS, zero regressions. commit 516e6ef.

⚓ ☃
title: Camp minion aggro+chase+leash, Pyromancer caster archetype
